direct_claims: This chart is a stacked area chart showing the estimated annual number of deaths from protein-energy malnutrition globally from 1980 to 2023, categorized by age groups.
The visualization was produced by Our World in Data using data sourced from the IHME Global Burden of Disease (2025) study.
Protein-energy malnutrition (PEM) is a critical public health metric representing severe systemic lack of food and nutrients.

The chart's subtitle cautions that these estimates carry wide uncertainties, particularly for countries with poor vital registration systems, meaning actual historical mortality could be higher or lower than visualized.
